searchText: Imo, we should still push for this (8237) in glamsterdam, otherwise hegota. Right now, my feeling is that mandatory proofs are still far away (at least 2-3 years) and it's worth to improve on the status quo of today. Glamsterdam will already come with a significant sync improvement on the EL (snap/2) and the CL could leverage the fact that we don't necessarily need to download payloads anymore too, making glam THE fork improving not only on scaling but also on sync. Good luck championing this one 🤣
